title: Color-Chat
description: Minecraft Beta 1.7.3 Colorised chat rank plugin
body:
# Beta 1.7.3 Color Chat

## Overview
The **Color Chat Plugin** for **Minecraft Beta 1.7.3** tested **Bukkit-0.0.0-980-g4ed23b1-b1060jnks** adds customizable chat colors and player ranks. It allows server admins to manage chat appearance directly in-game without needing constant config edits.

## Features
- **Chat Color Support**
  - Players and ranks can have colored chat messages.
  - Improves readability and adds personality to conversations.

- **Rank System**
  - Assign ranks to players with distinct chat formats.
  - Easily distinguish admins, moderators, and regular players.

- **In-Game Configuration Commands**
  - Manage colors and ranks without restarting the server.
  - Quick and efficient adjustments during live gameplay.

## Configuration
- Default settings are generated on first run.
- Modify rank formats and color codes via config or commands.
- Supports classic Minecraft color codes (e.g., `&a`, `&b`, etc.).

## Compatibility
- **Minecraft Version:** Beta 1.7.3
